title: Sources: a Silicon Valley war room, including Travis Kalanick, Gavin Baker, Brad Gerstner, and Marc Andreessen, lobbied Trump and JD Vance to reinstate Huang (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: a Silicon Valley war room, including Travis Kalanick, Gavin Baker, Brad Gerstner, and Marc Andreessen, lobbied Trump and JD Vance to reinstate Huang — Silicon Valley titans enlisted US president and JD Vance to rescue the billionaire tech boss whom they viewed as critical for the AI industry
